bio: Perched atop the rocky cliffside on an enchanting peninsula between Nice and Monaco, this hotel is one of the most secluded and exclusive spots on the Côte d'Azur. Access is via a discreet gate, then a winding path that seems to draw you away from the world. Dining on the terrace here, lulled by the swaying palms of a Mediterranean garden, feels like a rare privilege. Kevin Garcia, former executive chef for Frédéric Anton at Le Jules Verne enhances the blissful experience with his homage to seafood, garden herbs and top-quality locally grown vegetables.
